requirement: Soft delete an antibiogram by ID: load the live record, stamp IsDeleted and DeletedAt, keep the antibiotic joins and referenced pathogen, and report an unknown or already-deleted ID as not found.

preconditions.text: A live antibiogram exists for the target ID
Reference pathogen and antibiotic entities exist
The target ID does not match any live antibiogram
A soft-deleted antibiogram exists for the target ID

inputs.text: Delete request for a live antibiogram with one antibiotic join
Delete request for a live antibiogram with three antibiotic joins
Delete request with an unknown antibiogram ID
Delete request with Guid.Empty as the ID
Delete request for an antibiogram that is already soft-deleted

returns.text: Success with Deleted status; IsDeleted and DeletedAt are set
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Antibiogram not found' error
Joins, pathogen, and antibiotics are retained; other antibiograms stay live

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing antibiogram is returned as a failed Result
